inj.note: Head coach Mike Macdonald labeled Darnold week-to-week Wednesday while adding that Darnold isn't expected to be placed on injured reserve due to his injury. Backup Drew Lock missed the previous two games due to an elbow injury but has a chance to return Sunday against the Cardinals and take over the starting role. If Lock isn't ready to suit up, 2025 third-round pick Jalen Milroe could be tabbed for the first regular-season start of the latter's NFL career. Per Henderson, Macdonald also revealed that Darnold suffered a cracked rib on the second play of Seattle's Week 8 loss to the Bears, but the QB managed to play through that injury and eventually injured his quadriceps late in the game.

news.h: Seahawks' Quenton Nelson, Sam Darnold among starters ruled out
news.d: New Seahawks trade acquisition Quenton Nelson will have a "minor procedure" and is one of six starters, including QB Sam Darnold, who won't play vs. the Cardinals.

news.h: Seahawks' Lock says elbow feeling 'better' ahead of start vs. Cardinals
news.d: Seattle Seahawks backup quarterback Drew Lock, who's in line to start this week with Sam Darnold sidelined, says the elbow injury that made him inactive for the past two games is "doing a lot better."

news.h: Coach: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold ruled out with quad injury, is week-to-week
news.d: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will miss Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals because of a quad injury, coach Mike Macdonald announced Wednesday.

news.h: Sam Darnold is struggling under pressure, but Seahawks patient with O-line
news.d: Seattle's trade for Quenton Nelson last week shuffled the offensive line ahead of its decisive loss to the Bears. Will the pass protection get better?
